registered_before: any V0.6 hydrological feature was computed, viewed or modelled
status: exploratory grouped cross-validation on already seen events (V0.5 cohort); no new sealed or external test
plan: reports/weiterentwicklung_2026-10-15/UMSETZUNGSPLAN.md, package P3.1 (renumbered V0.6 because V0.5 was already used for the neighbour-slope design)
question: Do hydrological summaries of the hourly INCA rain history (antecedent precipitation index, intensity-duration maxima, wet-day counts, dry spells, rain plus snowmelt) add ranking skill beyond the V0.5 temporal features for the documented slope against ten unmatched surrounding slopes?
primary_endpoint: conditional logit: unit-weighted local AUC of combined_hydro minus combined (paired, same groups/folds/purge), median over the 5 registered repetitions; 95 % interval from the unit bootstrap of repetition 1 (2000 draws, seed 20261015)
decision_rule: A hydrological benefit is called established only if the paired bootstrap interval of the primary difference excludes zero; otherwise 'no established benefit'. All four paired comparisons (2 models x {temporal, combined}) are reported; none is selected after the fact.
must_not_change: V0.5 dataset, cohort freeze, CV plan and results

inputs.cohort: the 418 frozen V0.5 groups (4 598 samples), identical positives, controls, t0, folds and spatial purge
inputs.weather_source: hourly INCA v1 RR from the already cached V0.4/V0.5 responses; a cache miss is an error, no download

hydrology.boundary_rule: identical to V0.4: hourly value at T admissible iff T + 1 h < t0; 60-day window additionally T - 1 h >= t0 - 60 d (1438 hours)
hydrology.api_definition: API_t = k * API_{t-1} + RR_t with k = 0.5 ** (1 / (24 * half_life_days)), start 0 at the first admissible hour of the 60-day window, value at the last admissible hour (truncation of the 14-day memory at 60 days is accepted and reported)
hydrology.max_sum_definition: maximum over the admissible 60-day window of the rolling sum of RR over h consecutive hours; the time feature is hours between the end of the maximising interval (last hour T + 1 h) and t0, latest maximum on ties
hydrology.wet_day_blocks: 24-hour blocks counted backwards from the last admissible hour (not calendar days); incomplete leading remainder discarded
hydrology.dry_spell: longest run of dry hours in the 60-day window (hours) and the current run of dry hours up to the last admissible hour
hydrology.available_water: rain_sum_Nd + swe_melt_Nd for N in 3, 7, 14 from existing V0.4 features (SNOWGRID day boundary differs from the t0-anchored rain window; documented); missing if swe_melt is missing
hydrology.missing_values: same rule as V0.5 (conditional logit: group-wise training mean; boosting: native); no invented values; a series that fails the V0.4 completeness/plausibility rule never reached the cohort

variants.combined: V0.5 static + temporal (+ V0.5 interactions for conditional logit)
variants.combined_hydro: combined + hydrological (same V0.5 interactions, no new interactions)

models: conditional_logit (primary) and hist_gradient_boosting with the unchanged V0.5 hyperparameters; no tuning, no seed search
cross_validation: the frozen V0.5 plan (5 folds x 5 repetitions, purged primary), unchanged
metrics: unchanged V0.5 definitions (local AUC unit-weighted, top-1, top-3, mrr)

diagnostics.stanz: primary difference with the largest (2016 Stanz) unit removed, same predictions
diagnostics.correlation: maximum absolute Spearman correlation of each hydrological feature with the V0.5 temporal features (redundancy check)
diagnostics.coverage: share of non-missing values per hydrological feature, by class

interpretation_limits: predictive importance is not causation; INCA 1 km hourly rain is a coarse proxy of slope-scale rainfall; rain after t0 on the event day is invisible; events already seen in V0.4/V0.5 so results are exploratory
